3_verdict: CONFIRMS and STRENGTHENS the null: min detectable effect at these n is d~1.3-1.5 (alpha .05, 80% power, rule-of-thumb), while the observed effect vs T64B is only d~0.71 (~0.38s mean diff). A true difference of that size would routinely fail to reach significance at n=9 vs n=7 -- the "cannot be compared" call is well-founded, if anything understated as a caution.

The two V282 groups do NOT share a ~151 deg/s max: V282old reaches 151.0 (event-detected peak) / 154.0 (raw, <15 m/s); V282 only reaches 108.2 (event) and its own RAW max is 159.8 deg/s -- HIGHER than 151, not capped at it. 151 is the V282old event-detected max alone, not a value both groups hit.
